definitions.explanation: A photo album created to preserve memories of a special occasion such as a graduation, wedding, or school year.

examples.japanese: {卒業|そつぎょう}{記念|きねん}アルバムが{届|とど}いた。
{結婚式|けっこんしき}の{記念|きねん}アルバムを{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered a commemorative album of the wedding ceremony.

examples.japanese: {記念|きねん}アルバムを{開|ひら}くたびに、{楽|たの}しかった{学生|がくせい}{時代|じだい}を{思|おも}い{出|だ}す。
examples.english: Every time I open the commemorative album, I remember my fun school days.

notes:
Combines {記念|きねん} (commemoration, memorial) with the loanword アルバム (album). In Japan, {卒業|そつぎょう}{記念|きねん}アルバム (graduation albums) are a deeply rooted tradition. Most schools produce professional-quality albums at the end of the school year, and they are treasured keepsakes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卒業|そつぎょう}{記念|きねん}アルバム: graduation commemorative album
- {結婚|けっこん}{記念|きねん}アルバム: wedding commemorative album
- {記念|きねん}アルバムを{作|つく}る: to make a commemorative album
- {記念|きねん}アルバムに{載|の}る: to appear in a commemorative album

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese school graduation albums ({卒業|そつぎょう}アルバム) typically contain class photos, individual portraits, and candid shots from school events throughout the year. They are produced by professional photographers and are a standard part of the graduation experience at all school levels.
